This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow).     phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],

This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

# Team Documentation Workflow

Collaboration centered on the `docs/` directory.

## Knowledge Architecture (domain-axis)

Docs are organized by what they're *about*, not by lifecycle stage. A doc's freshness lives in its TL;DR (and `Last touched:` for active areas) — not by which directory it sits in. Completed work stays co-located with its domain. There is no `archives/` directory — if a doc no longer earns its keep, delete it; if a lasting lesson hides inside it, lift that lesson into `lessons/` first, then delete.

```
docs/
├── index.md           # Routing table — every doc must be listed here
├── roadmap/           # Strategic plans, quarterly direction, milestones
├── models/<line>/     # Per-model living docs (qwen3, qwen35, kimi-k2, ...)
│                      # — design, accuracy, perf, refactor records, gotchas
├── subsystems/<area>/ # Cross-cutting components (runtime, scheduler, frontend, kernels)
├── playbooks/         # Reusable how-to: benching, profiling, accuracy, onboarding
├── lessons/           # Tribal knowledge from research / other projects
├── benchmarks/        # Standalone benchmark snapshots and eval reports
├── conventions/       # Ongoing standards (bench regression, coding style)
└── private/           # Local-only notes (gitignored)
```

Classification rule at capture time:
- Is it tied to a specific model? → `models/<line>/`
- A specific subsystem? → `subsystems/<area>/`
- Reusable how-to applicable across models? → `playbooks/`
- Lasting lesson from elsewhere (other repo, research, postmortem)? → `lessons/`
- Snapshot of measurement, not a doc that evolves? → `benchmarks/`
- Strategic / cross-cutting plan? → `roadmap/`

If you can't pick one, the doc probably needs splitting.

## Documentation Style

- Docs cover what `--help` and code can't: pitfalls, diagnostic paths, decision context. Don't restate CLI reference.
- Every command in a doc must be run and verified before committing. Unverified commands are technical debt.
- The only required header is a one-line **TL;DR**. Keep it true; that's the contract.
- For `models/<line>/` and `subsystems/<area>/` docs, add `Last touched: YYYY-MM` and bump it when you do meaningful work on the doc (not for typo fixes). The date is a fact, not a judgement — readers infer freshness themselves.
- `playbooks/`, `lessons/`, `conventions/`, `roadmap/`, `benchmarks/`, `archives/` don't need a freshness stamp. They're either timeless until disproven, or self-dated, or explicitly inert.
- No `Status:` enum. Enum fields go stale exactly when you need them most.

## index.md Drift Policy

`index.md` is a routing table with a scanning-friendly TL;DR column. It is *allowed to drift* from the TL;DR inside each doc — the doc body is authoritative. Update `index.md` when you create or delete a doc, or when the existing TL;DR is so wrong it actively misleads. Don't churn it on every doc edit.

## Core Principles (CODE)

Documentation exists to advance work, not to hoard information. Four steps when handling information:

1. **Capture**: Only record what materially advances the project. When in doubt, leave it out.
2. **Organize**: Action-oriented. Resist the urge to organize for organization's sake — structure should be just enough.
3. **Distill**: Refactor over append. When you learn something new or hit a pitfall, integrate it into the document body — don't pile a changelog at the bottom.
4. **Express**: Every document must point to a next step. Split unwieldy documents proactively. Active documents must note the current blocker or next action.

## Collaboration Lifecycle

**Sync**

At the start of each session, you must read `index.md` and load the documents needed for the task at hand.

**Execute**
- Update relevant documents as you go. When a new problem or idea arises, create a document in the appropriate domain directory (see classification rule above).
- Record *why* a decision was made, not just *what* was done.

**Commit**

When a session wraps up:
- Update the TL;DR (and `Last touched`, where applicable) at the top of each modified document.
- Update `index.md` only when you created or deleted a doc, or when its TL;DR row is now misleading (see Drift Policy above).

1	# u1-l2 CLI 与服务器引导:legacy 定时模式与 --profile 档案模式
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	上一讲我们从整体上认识了 pegainfer-sim:一个纯 CPU 的"假"推理引擎,用来在没有 GPU 的环境下验证 vLLM 兼容前端。本讲我们精读它的二进制入口 `src/main.rs`,学完后你应该能够:
6	
7	1. 说出 **legacy 定时模式**与 **--profile 档案模式**各自的参数集,以及每个参数在用户未提供时的默认值(`DEFAULT_*` 常量)。
8	2. 解释 `--profile` 与三个定时参数互斥的防御逻辑:它检查什么、为什么放在最前面、报错文案长什么样。
9	3. 完整跟踪 `main()` 的启动路径:从 clap 参数解析 → `build_runtime` 组装配置 → `start_engine` 装配引擎 → `pegainfer_frontend::vllm::serve` 把引擎挂到 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务上,并把 `serve` 的 8 个参数一一对应到来源。
10	
11	`main.rs` 只有约 260 行,但它是"两条车道"在进程层面的分岔点,读懂它,后面单元的所有内容都有了落脚处。
12	
13	## 2. 前置知识
14	
15	本讲会用到以下几个 Rust 生态的基础概念,先通俗地过一遍:
16	
17	- **clap derive 宏**:`#[derive(Parser)]` 让一个结构体变成命令行参数的定义。Rust 字段名的 snake_case 会自动映射成 CLI 的 kebab-case,例如字段 `base_ttft_ms` 对应选项 `--base-ttft-ms`。字段上方 `///` 文档注释会变成 `--help` 里的参数说明。
18	- **两种"默认值"策略**:
19	  - `#[arg(long, default_value_t = 8000)]`:clap 层默认值,字段类型是具体类型(如 `u16`),程序里拿到的**永远有值**,无法区分"用户传了 8000"和"没传"。
20	  - 字段类型是 `Option<f64>`、代码里 `unwrap_or(DEFAULT_X)`:代码层默认值,**能区分"用户给没给"**。本讲的互斥校验正是靠这个区别实现的——只有 `Option::is_some()` 才知道用户显式提供了参数。
21	- **anyhow 三件套**(本 crate 统一用 `anyhow` 做错误处理):
22	  - `ensure!(cond, "msg")`:条件不成立时返回错误 `msg`;
23	  - `bail!("msg")`:无条件返回错误(等价于 `ensure!(false, ...)`);
24	  - `.with_context(|| "msg")`:给 `Result` 的错误包一层上下文,最终错误链会显示成 `msg: 底层错误`。
25	- **`std::sync::Once`**:保证一段代码在整个进程里只执行一次。日志系统全局只能安装一次,重复安装会 panic,所以用 `Once` 防护——测试代码会多次调用 `init_logging()`,这个防护是必需的。
26	- **承接 u1-l1 的认知**:pegainfer-sim 有两条互斥的调度车道——legacy 车道用固定 TTFT/TPOT 定时;`--profile` 车道由校准档案(JSON)决定调度与步计时。本讲讲的就是这两条车道在 CLI 层的分岔。
27	
28	其中 TTFT(首 token 延迟)在 legacy 车道里由两个参数共同决定:
29	
30	\[ \text{TTFT} = \texttt{base\_ttft\_ms} + \frac{\texttt{prompt\_len}}{\texttt{prefill\_tokens\_per\_ms}} \]
31	
32	即"固定起步开销 + 按 prefill 吞吐折算的 prompt 处理时间"。TPOT 则是每个生成 token 之间的固定间隔 `tpot_ms`。这两个公式的完整执行语义在 u2-l1 展开,本讲只需要理解参数含义。
33	
34	## 3. 本讲源码地图
35	
36	| 文件 | 作用 | 本讲涉及程度 |
37	|------|------|------------|
38	| [pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs) | 二进制入口:CLI 定义、两种模式的组装、启动前端 | **本讲主角,逐段精读** |
39	| [pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs) | `SimulatedEngineConfig::new` / `with_*` builder / `start_engine` | 只看签名,下一讲(u1-l3)深入 |
40	| [pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs) | `EngineProfile::load_from_path` 与 `LoadedEngineProfile` | 只看加载入口,单元三深入 |
41	| [pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs) | `serve` 的完整签名、`shutdown_token_from_ctrl_c` | 看 `main()` 最后一个调用的契约 |
42	| [pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs) | e2e 测试:`spawn_once` 是 `main()` 的测试侧样板;`TINY_*` 常量提供最小模型元数据 | 实践环节取材 |

44	
45	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
46	
47	### 4.1 Args:clap 参数定义与两条车道的参数集
48	
49	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
50	
51	`Args` 结构体是整个 CLI 的单一事实来源。理解它的关键是把 8 个参数按"哪条车道用它"分成三组:
52	
53	- **通用参数**:`model_id`、`model_path`、`port`、`fallback_token_id`、`profile`——两条车道都认,但**语义**可能随车道变化(例如 `model_id` 在 legacy 模式下还兼作元数据目录路径的默认值,在 profile 模式下则必须与档案声明的模型一致)。
54	- **legacy 车道定时参数**:`base_ttft_ms`、`prefill_tokens_per_ms`、`tpot_ms`——只在 legacy 车道有效,与 `--profile` 互斥。
55	- **半通用参数**:`max_model_len`——两条车道都接受,但 profile 车道把它当**校验项**(必须与档案一致),legacy 车道把它当**配置项**(直接采用)。
56	
57	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
58	
59	clap 拿到命令行后:
60	
61	1. 把 `--model-id xxx` 之类的 kebab-case 选项匹配到对应字段;
62	2. 有 `default_value_t` 的字段直接填默认值(`port`、`fallback_token_id`);
63	3. 其余可选项不出现时保持 `None`;
64	4. 解析失败(类型不符、未知选项)时打印用法并退出。
65	
66	随后 `Args` 被**原样传给** `build_runtime`,由后者——而不是 clap——来做跨参数的校验(互斥、与档案冲突)。这是一个值得注意的分层:clap 只管"单个参数的语法",业务约束全部集中在 `build_runtime`。
67	
68	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
69	
70	六个默认值常量集中定义在文件顶部,方便一眼扫出 legacy 车道的"出厂设置":
71	
72	[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L14-L19](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L14-L19) 定义了 `DEFAULT_MODEL_ID`("Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B")、`DEFAULT_MAX_MODEL_LEN`(8192)、`DEFAULT_BASE_TTFT_MS`(5.0ms)、`DEFAULT_PREFILL_TOKENS_PER_MS`(100.0)、`DEFAULT_TPOT_MS`(12.0ms)和 `DEFAULT_FALLBACK_TOKEN_ID`(0)。注意只有最后一个被 clap 直接引用,其余都是代码层默认。
73	
74	[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L23-L28](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L23-L28) 是 derive 声明与 `about` 文案——`--help` 第一行就来自这里("CPU-only simulated inference server for OpenAI/vLLM serving benchmarks")。
75	
76	[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L29-L37](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L29-L37) 定义 `model_id` 与 `model_path`,二者的文档注释明确写出了车道差异:`model_id` 在 legacy 模式"还兼作元数据路径",在 profile 模式"必须匹配档案的目标模型 id";`model_path` 在 profile 模式下"可以与档案的目标模型 id 不同"(即档案描述的是被校准的真实引擎,而本地 tokenizer 可以是另一个小模型)。
77	
78	[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L59-L65](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L59-L65) 展示了两种默认值策略的对比:`fallback_token_id` 用 `default_value_t`(clap 层默认,字段是具体的 `u32`),`profile` 是 `Option<PathBuf>`(是否提供 `--profile` 本身就是车道选择开关)。
79	
80	#### 4.1.4 代码实践
81	
82	1. **实践目标**:把 CLI 表面完整看一遍,验证参数名与文档注释的映射。
83	2. **操作步骤**:在仓库根目录运行 `cargo run --release -p pegainfer-sim -- --help`(注意工作区默认成员不含本 crate,`-p pegainfer-sim` 不能省)。
84	3. **需要观察的现象**:帮助文本里 8 个选项的名称与说明;`--port` 与 `--fallback-token-id` 显示各自的默认值 8000 与 0。
85	4. **预期结果**:能看到全部选项列表;再故意传一个未定义选项(如 `--tpot`),clap 会报 "unexpected argument" 并建议 `--tpot-ms`。
86	5. 以上均为 clap 的确定性行为;具体帮助文案排版**待本地验证**。
87	
88	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
89	
90	**练习 1**:`base_ttft_ms` 为什么用 `Option<f64>` + 代码层默认,而不是像 `port` 那样用 `default_value_t`?
91	
92	> **答案**:因为互斥校验需要区分"用户显式提供了 `--base-ttft-ms`"与"未提供"。`default_value_t` 会让字段永远有值,`is_some()` 永远为真,`ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent` 就无法工作了。见 [main.rs:L156](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L156)。
93	
94	**练习 2**:legacy 车道下 TTFT 公式 \(\text{TTFT} = 5 + \frac{\text{prompt\_len}}{100}\) 毫秒,一个 2000 token 的 prompt 首延迟是多少?
95	
96	> **答案**:\(5 + 2000/100 = 25\) 毫秒。`prefill_tokens_per_ms` 就是把 prompt 长度折算成毫秒的"吞吐"系数。
97	
98	**练习 3**:`--profile` 指定的文件路径,与 `--model-path` 指定的目录,分别装着什么?
99	
100	> **答案**:`--profile` 指向校准档案 JSON(版本化 timing + scheduler 画像,旁边还要有 manifest,见 u3-l1);`--model-path` 指向 tokenizer/模型元数据目录(`tokenizer.json`、`config.json` 等),是 vLLM 前端搭协议栈用的。
101	
102	### 4.2 build_runtime:两条车道的分岔点
103	
104	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
105	
106	`build_runtime` 把 `Args` 翻译成一个 `RuntimeConfig`——引擎配置 + 前端服务所需的全部信息。它是整个 main.rs 里唯一有"业务逻辑"的函数,所有防御性校验都集中在这里。
107	
108	`RuntimeConfig` 的五个字段([main.rs:L68-L75](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L68-L75)):`engine`(给 `start_engine` 的引擎配置)、`model_path`(前端元数据目录)、`served_model_name`(对外模型名列表)、`max_model_len`(报告给前端的上下文上限)、`profile`(加载好的档案,legacy 车道为 `None`)。
109	
110	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
111	
112	```text
113	build_runtime(args):
114	  if args.profile 存在:                      # ── profile 车道
115	      1. 定时参数必须全部缺席(否则 bail)
116	      2. load_from_path 加载档案(读 JSON + manifest + sha256 校验)
117	      3. 若给了 --model-id,必须等于档案 model_id
118	      4. 若给了 --max-model-len,必须等于档案 max_model_len
119	      5. engine = 默认配置 + fallback_token_id + 档案
120	      6. model_path 默认取 model_id 字符串
121	  else:                                       # ── legacy 车道
122	      1. model_id 三级回退:--model-id → --model-path 字符串 → DEFAULT_MODEL_ID
123	      2. model_path 默认 = model_id(作为路径)
124	      3. max_model_len 默认 8192,必须 > 0
125	      4. 三个定时参数各取默认值
126	      5. engine = SimulatedEngineConfig::new(四个值)
127	      6. served_model_name 仅当 --model-path 与 --model-id 同时给出才非空
128	```
129

160	### 4.3 ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent:互斥防御
161	
162	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
163	
164	这条防线解决的问题是:**定时数据只能有一个真相**。profile 车道的步时长来自档案的校准测量(三线性插值,见 u3-l3),如果允许同时传 `--tpot-ms`,就会出现"档案说一步 8ms、CLI 说一步 12ms"的无声冲突——无论哪边赢,基准数据都可解释性尽失。所以选择 **fail-fast**:启动即拒绝,并解释原因。
165	
166	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
167	
168	```text
169	ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent(args):
170	  flags = [("--base-ttft-ms",            是否提供),
171	           ("--prefill-tokens-per-ms",   是否提供),
172	           ("--tpot-ms",                 是否提供)]
173	  找到第一个"已提供"的 (name, true):
174	      bail!("{name} cannot be combined with --profile; timing comes from the profile")
175	  否则 Ok(())
176	```
177	
178	用 `(名字, 是否提供)` 的数组字面量 + `find` 写校验,加新参数只需加一行元组,且报错信息天然带上**CLI 风格的参数名**。
179	
180	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
181	
182	[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L154-L167](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L154-L167) 是完整实现:`provided` 数组列出三个定时参数及其 `is_some()` 状态;`provided.into_iter().find(|(_, present)| *present)` 定位第一个被显式提供的参数;`if let Some((name, true))` 解构后 `bail!`。注意它的调用点在 [main.rs:L79](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L79)——`build_runtime` 进入 profile 分支后的**第一件事**,先于任何文件 I/O:冲突是最便宜的失败,应最先暴露。

206	### 4.4 report_profile 与 init_logging:启动横幅与日志系统
207	
208	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
209	
210	启动时有两类输出,职责不同:
211	
212	- **启动横幅**(`report_profile`,`eprintln!` 直写 stderr):不受日志级别过滤,永远打印。它的价值是基准测试留档——跑基准时把 stderr 存下来,就永久记录了"这次用的哪个档案、什么调度参数、覆盖域是什么"。

214	
215	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
216	
217	`init_logging` 用 `Once` 保证全局只安装一次:读 `RUST_LOG` 环境变量(默认 `info`)→ 构造 EnvFilter → 给 logforth 挂一个 Stderr appender → apply。`report_profile` 则按车道打印:legacy 一行话;profile 一大行结构化字段(路径、manifest、sha256、目标引擎、版本、模型、GPU、调度参数、覆盖域)。

249	### 4.5 main():从参数到 vllm::serve 的完整启动路径
250	
251	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
252	
253	`main` 把前四个模块串成一条线,终点是前端的 `serve`。`serve` 的第一个参数值得单独理解:它要的不是引擎,而是**一个产出引擎的 Future**——这允许真实引擎做耗时的异步初始化(加载权重等);sim 引擎是同步构造好的,所以用 `std::future::ready(Ok(engine.into()))` 包成"立即就绪"的 future。这是 sim 与真实引擎在启动契约上的唯一差异。
254	
255	#### 4.5.2 核心流程
256	
257	```text
258	main():
259	  1. init_logging()                 # 装日志(Once)
260	  2. Args::parse()                  # clap 解析(语法层)
261	  3. build_runtime(&args)?          # 业务校验 + 组装 RuntimeConfig
262	  4. report_profile(&runtime)       # 打启动横幅(stderr)
263	  5. start_engine(&runtime.engine)  # 装配 Engine(起调度线程,下一讲)
264	  6. vllm::serve(...).await         # 挂 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP,阻塞到停机
265	```
266	
267	任何一步失败(`?`)进程即退出,错误链由 anyhow 打印——步骤 3 的三类校验(互斥、model_id 冲突、max_model_len 冲突)都发生在这里。

269	#### 4.5.3 源码精读
270	
271	[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L207-L225](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L207-L225) 是 `main` 全文,8 个 `serve` 实参与 `RuntimeConfig`/`Args` 的对应关系:
272	
273	| 实参 | 来源 | 说明 |
274	|------|------|------|
275	| `std::future::ready(Ok(engine.into()))` | 第 5 步的 `engine` | 立即就绪的引擎 future;`into()` 转为前端的 `LaunchedEngine` |
276	| `&runtime.model_path` | `build_runtime` | tokenizer/config 元数据目录 |
277	| `runtime.served_model_name` | `build_runtime` | 对外模型名(空 Vec 时前端自行推导) |
278	| `ParserSelection::Auto` | 常量 | 工具调用解析器自动选择(按模型路径,见 [model_line.rs:L314-L321](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L314-L321) 的解析逻辑;u4-l3 详解) |

297	**练习 1**:`serve` 的第一个参数为什么是 Future 而不是 `Engine`?
298	
299	> **答案**:给异步初始化的引擎留出契约空间(权重加载可能几十秒)。sim 引擎同步构造,用 `std::future::ready` 立即满足;真实引擎可以在 future 里慢慢初始化,前端在等待期间可以继续做自己的准备。
300	
301	**练习 2**:`Some(runtime.max_model_len)` 里这个 `Option` 表达什么?
302	
303	> **答案**:对前端而言 `None` 意味着"由前端/模型配置自行决定上下文上限"。sim 永远显式给值(legacy 8192 或档案值),把决定权握在自己手里,保证报告给 `/v1/models` 的元数据与调度上限一致。
304	
305	**练习 3**:e2e 测试为什么不用 `shutdown_token_from_ctrl_c()`?
306	
307	> **答案**:测试进程里 Ctrl-C 不可编程控制;测试用自建的 `CancellationToken` 克隆一份传给 serve,`server.shutdown()` 时 cancel 即可确定性停机(`spawn_once` L207 的 `shutdown` 与 L209 的 `server_shutdown` 就是这一对克隆)。
308	
309	## 5. 综合实践
310	
311	把本讲的实践任务完整走一遍:启动服务器、验证三个端点、触发互斥报错。
312	
313	**(1) 构造最小模型元数据目录**
314	
315	前端搭 vLLM 协议栈需要 `tokenizer.json`、`tokenizer_config.json`、`config.json` 三个文件(e2e 测试的 [model_dir_with_minimal_metadata](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L373-L390) 就是这么写的,注释说明:token-id prompt 免编码,但**生成的 id 仍需 tokenizer 解码**)。在 pegainfer-sim 目录下建 `tmp-model/`,放入三个文件——`tokenizer.json` 直接照抄 [TINY_TOKENIZER_JSON](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L2106-L2136)(WordLevel 词表 `{"<unk>": 0, "alpha": 1, "beta": 2}`),`tokenizer_config.json` 照抄 [L2138-L2142](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L2138-L2142),`config.json` 照抄 [TINY_CONFIG_JSON](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L2153-L2157)。
316	
317	**(2) 构建并启动**
318	
319	```bash
320	cargo build --release -p pegainfer-sim
321	./target/release/pegainfer-sim --port 8001 --model-path tmp-model
322	```
323	
324	预期 stderr 首行为 `active engine profile: legacy fixed TTFT/TPOT scheduler`,随后是前端监听日志(排版待本地验证)。
325	
326	**(3) 三个端点逐一试**
327	
328	```bash
329	curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8001/health
330	curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1/models
331	curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1/completions \
332	  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
333	  -d '{"model":"tmp-model","prompt":[1,2],"max_tokens":4}'
334	```
335	
336	- `/health`:预期成功(2xx)。响应体格式待本地验证。
337	- `/v1/models`:预期 `object: "list"`;`data[0].id` 与 `model_path` 推导出的模型名相关(本例未同时给 `--model-id`,`served_model_name` 为空,由前端推导)。
338	- `/v1/completions`:token id `[1, 2]` 经词表解码为 `alpha beta`(id→词的映射即 tokenizer.json 的 vocab);生成的 4 个 token 均为 fallback id 0(`<unk>`)。可断言:`finish_reason == "length"`、`usage.prompt_tokens == 2`、`usage.completion_tokens == 4`、响应耗时约 \(5 + 2/100 + 3 \times 12 \approx 41\) 毫秒量级(首 token TTFT + 后续 3 个间隔;网络开销另计)。生成 text 的确切拼接(是否带空格)**待本地验证**。
339	
340	**(4) 触发互斥报错**
341	
342	```bash
343	./target/release/pegainfer-sim \
344	  --profile tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.json --tpot-ms 12
345	```
346	
347	预期:进程立即退出,stderr 含 `--tpot-ms cannot be combined with --profile; timing comes from the profile`。对照 4.3 节源码,理解这句文案的两个成分:哪个参数非法(`{name}`)+ 为什么("timing comes from the profile")。
348	
349	**(5) 反向确认 profile 车道可用**(选做)
350	
351	去掉 `--tpot-ms` 再跑第 4 步的命令,并为档案模型准备元数据目录:`--model-path tmp-model`(档案 `model_id` 为 `pegainfer-sim-zero-cost`,见 [tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.manifest.json](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.manifest.json),`model_path` 允许与之不同)。预期横幅变成 4.4 节描述的长行,`max_model_len` 等取档案值。档案车道的完整行为在 u3-l4 展开。
352	
353	## 6. 本讲小结
354	
355	- `Args` 用 `Option<T>` + 代码层默认(而非 `default_value_t`)承载三个定时参数,唯一目的就是让互斥校验能分辨"用户显式提供"。
356	- `build_runtime` 是两条车道的分岔点:profile 车道让档案成为模型身份与定时的唯一真相(CLI 只能确认不能改写),legacy 车道走 `model_id` 三级回退 + `DEFAULT_*` 常量。
357	- `ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent` 用"数组 + find + bail"实现 fail-fast 互斥,且放在档案加载之前——最便宜的失败最先暴露;报错文案同时回答"哪个参数"和"为什么"。
358	- `report_profile` 是不受 `RUST_LOG` 影响的启动横幅,profile 车道打印的 sha256/调度参数/覆盖域是基准留档的依据;`init_logging` 用 `Once` 保证日志系统只装一次。
359	- `main()` 六步走:`init_logging → parse → build_runtime → report → start_engine → vllm::serve`;`serve` 收一个"产出引擎的 Future",sim 用 `std::future::ready` 立即满足——这正是模拟引擎与真实引擎在启动契约上的唯一差异,e2e 测试的 `spawn_once` 与之一一对应。
360	
361	## 7. 下一步学习建议
362	
363	本讲我们两次把 `start_engine` 一笔带过。下一讲 **u1-l3《引擎契约接入:SimulatedEngineConfig 与 start_engine》**就补上这块:`SimulatedEngineConfig::new` 与全部 `with_*` builder 旋钮(脚本化补全、假想投机解码、假想前缀缓存等)、`start_engine_with_partitions` 如何用 `spawn_scheduler` 为每个分区起调度线程并装配前端可用的 `Engine`。建议先动手做一遍本讲综合实践,再进入下一讲——之后你阅读的每个 `spawn_with_config` 测试都会立刻眼熟。
364

# u1-l2 CLI 与服务器引导:legacy 定时模式与 --profile 档案模式

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲我们从整体上认识了 pegainfer-sim:一个纯 CPU 的"假"推理引擎,用来在没有 GPU 的环境下验证 vLLM 兼容前端。本讲我们精读它的二进制入口 `src/main.rs`,学完后你应该能够:

1. 说出 **legacy 定时模式**与 **--profile 档案模式**各自的参数集,以及每个参数在用户未提供时的默认值(`DEFAULT_*` 常量)。
2. 解释 `--profile` 与三个定时参数互斥的防御逻辑:它检查什么、为什么放在最前面、报错文案长什么样。
3. 完整跟踪 `main()` 的启动路径:从 clap 参数解析 → `build_runtime` 组装配置 → `start_engine` 装配引擎 → `pegainfer_frontend::vllm::serve` 把引擎挂到 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务上,并把 `serve` 的 8 个参数一一对应到来源。

`main.rs` 只有约 260 行,但它是"两条车道"在进程层面的分岔点,读懂它,后面单元的所有内容都有了落脚处。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲会用到以下几个 Rust 生态的基础概念,先通俗地过一遍:

- **clap derive 宏**:`#[derive(Parser)]` 让一个结构体变成命令行参数的定义。Rust 字段名的 snake_case 会自动映射成 CLI 的 kebab-case,例如字段 `base_ttft_ms` 对应选项 `--base-ttft-ms`。字段上方 `///` 文档注释会变成 `--help` 里的参数说明。
- **两种"默认值"策略**:
  - `#[arg(long, default_value_t = 8000)]`:clap 层默认值,字段类型是具体类型(如 `u16`),程序里拿到的**永远有值**,无法区分"用户传了 8000"和"没传"。
  - 字段类型是 `Option<f64>`、代码里 `unwrap_or(DEFAULT_X)`:代码层默认值,**能区分"用户给没给"**。本讲的互斥校验正是靠这个区别实现的——只有 `Option::is_some()` 才知道用户显式提供了参数。
- **anyhow 三件套**(本 crate 统一用 `anyhow` 做错误处理):
  - `ensure!(cond, "msg")`:条件不成立时返回错误 `msg`;
  - `bail!("msg")`:无条件返回错误(等价于 `ensure!(false, ...)`);
  - `.with_context(|| "msg")`:给 `Result` 的错误包一层上下文,最终错误链会显示成 `msg: 底层错误`。
- **`std::sync::Once`**:保证一段代码在整个进程里只执行一次。日志系统全局只能安装一次,重复安装会 panic,所以用 `Once` 防护——测试代码会多次调用 `init_logging()`,这个防护是必需的。
- **承接 u1-l1 的认知**:pegainfer-sim 有两条互斥的调度车道——legacy 车道用固定 TTFT/TPOT 定时;`--profile` 车道由校准档案(JSON)决定调度与步计时。本讲讲的就是这两条车道在 CLI 层的分岔。

其中 TTFT(首 token 延迟)在 legacy 车道里由两个参数共同决定:

\[ \text{TTFT} = \texttt{base\_ttft\_ms} + \frac{\texttt{prompt\_len}}{\texttt{prefill\_tokens\_per\_ms}} \]

即"固定起步开销 + 按 prefill 吞吐折算的 prompt 处理时间"。TPOT 则是每个生成 token 之间的固定间隔 `tpot_ms`。这两个公式的完整执行语义在 u2-l1 展开,本讲只需要理解参数含义。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 | 本讲涉及程度 |
|------|------|------------|
| [pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs) | 二进制入口:CLI 定义、两种模式的组装、启动前端 | **本讲主角,逐段精读** |
| [pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs) | `SimulatedEngineConfig::new` / `with_*` builder / `start_engine` | 只看签名,下一讲(u1-l3)深入 |
| [pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs) | `EngineProfile::load_from_path` 与 `LoadedEngineProfile` | 只看加载入口,单元三深入 |
| [pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs) | `serve` 的完整签名、`shutdown_token_from_ctrl_c` | 看 `main()` 最后一个调用的契约 |
| [pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs) | e2e 测试:`spawn_once` 是 `main()` 的测试侧样板;`TINY_*` 常量提供最小模型元数据 | 实践环节取材 |
| [pegainfer-sim/tests/fixtures/](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.json) | `online-zero-cost.json` 等校准档案 bundle | 实践环节的 `--profile` 输入 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Args:clap 参数定义与两条车道的参数集

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`Args` 结构体是整个 CLI 的单一事实来源。理解它的关键是把 8 个参数按"哪条车道用它"分成三组:

- **通用参数**:`model_id`、`model_path`、`port`、`fallback_token_id`、`profile`——两条车道都认,但**语义**可能随车道变化(例如 `model_id` 在 legacy 模式下还兼作元数据目录路径的默认值,在 profile 模式下则必须与档案声明的模型一致)。
- **legacy 车道定时参数**:`base_ttft_ms`、`prefill_tokens_per_ms`、`tpot_ms`——只在 legacy 车道有效,与 `--profile` 互斥。
- **半通用参数**:`max_model_len`——两条车道都接受,但 profile 车道把它当**校验项**(必须与档案一致),legacy 车道把它当**配置项**(直接采用)。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

clap 拿到命令行后:

1. 把 `--model-id xxx` 之类的 kebab-case 选项匹配到对应字段;
2. 有 `default_value_t` 的字段直接填默认值(`port`、`fallback_token_id`);
3. 其余可选项不出现时保持 `None`;
4. 解析失败(类型不符、未知选项)时打印用法并退出。

随后 `Args` 被**原样传给** `build_runtime`,由后者——而不是 clap——来做跨参数的校验(互斥、与档案冲突)。这是一个值得注意的分层:clap 只管"单个参数的语法",业务约束全部集中在 `build_runtime`。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

六个默认值常量集中定义在文件顶部,方便一眼扫出 legacy 车道的"出厂设置":

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L14-L19](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L14-L19) 定义了 `DEFAULT_MODEL_ID`("Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B")、`DEFAULT_MAX_MODEL_LEN`(8192)、`DEFAULT_BASE_TTFT_MS`(5.0ms)、`DEFAULT_PREFILL_TOKENS_PER_MS`(100.0)、`DEFAULT_TPOT_MS`(12.0ms)和 `DEFAULT_FALLBACK_TOKEN_ID`(0)。注意只有最后一个被 clap 直接引用,其余都是代码层默认。

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L23-L28](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L23-L28) 是 derive 声明与 `about` 文案——`--help` 第一行就来自这里("CPU-only simulated inference server for OpenAI/vLLM serving benchmarks")。

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L29-L37](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L29-L37) 定义 `model_id` 与 `model_path`,二者的文档注释明确写出了车道差异:`model_id` 在 legacy 模式"还兼作元数据路径",在 profile 模式"必须匹配档案的目标模型 id";`model_path` 在 profile 模式下"可以与档案的目标模型 id 不同"(即档案描述的是被校准的真实引擎,而本地 tokenizer 可以是另一个小模型)。

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L59-L65](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L59-L65) 展示了两种默认值策略的对比:`fallback_token_id` 用 `default_value_t`(clap 层默认,字段是具体的 `u32`),`profile` 是 `Option<PathBuf>`(是否提供 `--profile` 本身就是车道选择开关)。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**:把 CLI 表面完整看一遍,验证参数名与文档注释的映射。
2. **操作步骤**:在仓库根目录运行 `cargo run --release -p pegainfer-sim -- --help`(注意工作区默认成员不含本 crate,`-p pegainfer-sim` 不能省)。
3. **需要观察的现象**:帮助文本里 8 个选项的名称与说明;`--port` 与 `--fallback-token-id` 显示各自的默认值 8000 与 0。
4. **预期结果**:能看到全部选项列表;再故意传一个未定义选项(如 `--tpot`),clap 会报 "unexpected argument" 并建议 `--tpot-ms`。
5. 以上均为 clap 的确定性行为;具体帮助文案排版**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**:`base_ttft_ms` 为什么用 `Option<f64>` + 代码层默认,而不是像 `port` 那样用 `default_value_t`?

> **答案**:因为互斥校验需要区分"用户显式提供了 `--base-ttft-ms`"与"未提供"。`default_value_t` 会让字段永远有值,`is_some()` 永远为真,`ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent` 就无法工作了。见 [main.rs:L156](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L156)。

**练习 2**:legacy 车道下 TTFT 公式 \(\text{TTFT} = 5 + \frac{\text{prompt\_len}}{100}\) 毫秒,一个 2000 token 的 prompt 首延迟是多少?

> **答案**:\(5 + 2000/100 = 25\) 毫秒。`prefill_tokens_per_ms` 就是把 prompt 长度折算成毫秒的"吞吐"系数。

**练习 3**:`--profile` 指定的文件路径,与 `--model-path` 指定的目录,分别装着什么?

> **答案**:`--profile` 指向校准档案 JSON(版本化 timing + scheduler 画像,旁边还要有 manifest,见 u3-l1);`--model-path` 指向 tokenizer/模型元数据目录(`tokenizer.json`、`config.json` 等),是 vLLM 前端搭协议栈用的。

### 4.2 build_runtime:两条车道的分岔点

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`build_runtime` 把 `Args` 翻译成一个 `RuntimeConfig`——引擎配置 + 前端服务所需的全部信息。它是整个 main.rs 里唯一有"业务逻辑"的函数,所有防御性校验都集中在这里。

`RuntimeConfig` 的五个字段([main.rs:L68-L75](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L68-L75)):`engine`(给 `start_engine` 的引擎配置)、`model_path`(前端元数据目录)、`served_model_name`(对外模型名列表)、`max_model_len`(报告给前端的上下文上限)、`profile`(加载好的档案,legacy 车道为 `None`)。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
build_runtime(args):
  if args.profile 存在:                      # ── profile 车道
      1. 定时参数必须全部缺席(否则 bail)
      2. load_from_path 加载档案(读 JSON + manifest + sha256 校验)
      3. 若给了 --model-id,必须等于档案 model_id
      4. 若给了 --max-model-len,必须等于档案 max_model_len
      5. engine = 默认配置 + fallback_token_id + 档案
      6. model_path 默认取 model_id 字符串
  else:                                       # ── legacy 车道
      1. model_id 三级回退:--model-id → --model-path 字符串 → DEFAULT_MODEL_ID
      2. model_path 默认 = model_id(作为路径)
      3. max_model_len 默认 8192,必须 > 0
      4. 三个定时参数各取默认值
      5. engine = SimulatedEngineConfig::new(四个值)
      6. served_model_name 仅当 --model-path 与 --model-id 同时给出才非空
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

### 4.3 ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent:互斥防御

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

这条防线解决的问题是:**定时数据只能有一个真相**。profile 车道的步时长来自档案的校准测量(三线性插值,见 u3-l3),如果允许同时传 `--tpot-ms`,就会出现"档案说一步 8ms、CLI 说一步 12ms"的无声冲突——无论哪边赢,基准数据都可解释性尽失。所以选择 **fail-fast**:启动即拒绝,并解释原因。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent(args):
  flags = [("--base-ttft-ms",            是否提供),
           ("--prefill-tokens-per-ms",   是否提供),
           ("--tpot-ms",                 是否提供)]
  找到第一个"已提供"的 (name, true):
      bail!("{name} cannot be combined with --profile; timing comes from the profile")
  否则 Ok(())
```

用 `(名字, 是否提供)` 的数组字面量 + `find` 写校验,加新参数只需加一行元组,且报错信息天然带上**CLI 风格的参数名**。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L154-L167](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L154-L167) 是完整实现:`provided` 数组列出三个定时参数及其 `is_some()` 状态;`provided.into_iter().find(|(_, present)| *present)` 定位第一个被显式提供的参数;`if let Some((name, true))` 解构后 `bail!`。注意它的调用点在 [main.rs:L79](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L79)——`build_runtime` 进入 profile 分支后的**第一件事**,先于任何文件 I/O:冲突是最便宜的失败,应最先暴露。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**:亲手触发互斥报错,记住文案(它会在你以后误用命令行时立刻认出来)。
2. **操作步骤**:运行 `cargo run --release -p pegainfer-sim -- --profile tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.json --tpot-ms 12`(在 pegainfer-sim 目录内,fixture 才在相对路径上)。
3. **需要观察的现象**:进程退出码非 0,stderr 打印错误信息。
4. **预期结果**:错误信息为 `--tpot-ms cannot be combined with --profile; timing comes from the profile`。再把 `--tpot-ms` 换成 `--base-ttft-ms 3` 与 `--prefill-tokens-per-ms 50` 各试一次,文案中的参数名随之变化。
5. 这是纯内存分支,行为确定;唯一**待本地验证**的是 anyhow 错误在终端上的确切排版。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**:三个定时参数同时提供,报错信息提到几个?

> **答案**:只提到第一个(`--base-ttft-ms`)。`find` 只返回首个匹配——fail-fast 风格下修好一个错误自然会暴露下一个,一次全列反而稀释信息。

**练习 2**:这个校验为什么不用 clap 的 `conflicts_with` 声明来做?

> **答案**(开放讨论):clap 层的 `conflicts_with` 也能做,但这里互斥的语义是"定时真相属于档案"这一业务规则,与 `build_runtime` 里另外两个档案一致性校验(model_id、max_model_len)同属一层;集中在业务层让所有跨参数规则可在一处读到。(clap 与 anyhow 两种方案的报错时机与文案控制力也不同。)

> **答案**:它不属于"定时"——档案管的是调度与步时长,fallback token 是空 prompt 时的输出占位(输出内容层面的旋钮),与档案无冲突,所以两条车道共用(见 L100 显式传入)。

### 4.4 report_profile 与 init_logging:启动横幅与日志系统

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

启动时有两类输出,职责不同:

- **启动横幅**(`report_profile`,`eprintln!` 直写 stderr):不受日志级别过滤,永远打印。它的价值是基准测试留档——跑基准时把 stderr 存下来,就永久记录了"这次用的哪个档案、什么调度参数、覆盖域是什么"。
- **运行日志**(`logforth` 框架,受 `RUST_LOG` 过滤):分级(INFO/DEBUG/...)、按 target 过滤的常规日志。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

`init_logging` 用 `Once` 保证全局只安装一次:读 `RUST_LOG` 环境变量(默认 `info`)→ 构造 EnvFilter → 给 logforth 挂一个 Stderr appender → apply。`report_profile` 则按车道打印:legacy 一行话;profile 一大行结构化字段(路径、manifest、sha256、目标引擎、版本、模型、GPU、调度参数、覆盖域)。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L169-L173](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L169-L173) 是 legacy 车道的横幅:一行 `active engine profile: legacy fixed TTFT/TPOT scheduler`——这条信息量虽小,但让日志读者立刻知道当前在快车道。

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L174-L190](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L174-L190) 是 profile 车道的横幅,字段全部来自已加载的 `LoadedEngineProfile`(该结构在 [profile.rs:L180-L186](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L180-L186) 定义,含 `profile`、`manifest` 与两个路径字段,并 `Deref` 到 `EngineProfile`):`path`/`manifest`/`manifest_sha256` 三元组锁定数据来源,`target`/`version`/`model`/`revision`/`gpu` 描述被校准的真实引擎,`scheduler={:?}` 及三个调度参数、`predictor_coverage={:?}` 则是调度与计时的关键输入——这些概念在单元三逐一展开。

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L193-L205](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L193-L205) 是 `init_logging` 全文:`LOGGING_INIT.call_once`([L21](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L21) 定义)包裹 `EnvFilterBuilder::from_spec(...)` 到 `.apply()` 的安装流程。单元测试 [main.rs:L253-L257](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L253-L257) 的 `sim_logger_accepts_warn_records` 正是靠 `Once` 才能在测试里安全地再次调用 `init_logging()` 并断言 Warn 级别对 `pegainfer_sim::profile` target 可见。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**:观察横幅与日志两套输出的分离。
2. **操作步骤**:先默认启动(需要第 5 节的模型目录),记录 stderr 前几行;再用 `RUST_LOG=pegainfer_sim=debug cargo run --release -p pegainfer-sim -- ...` 启动一次。

> **答案**:`log::info!` 受 `RUST_LOG` 过滤,级别调高(如 `RUST_LOG=warn`)时横幅会消失;而"这次跑的是哪个档案"是基准记录的硬需求,必须无条件出现,所以直写 stderr。

### 4.5 main():从参数到 vllm::serve 的完整启动路径

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

`main` 把前四个模块串成一条线,终点是前端的 `serve`。`serve` 的第一个参数值得单独理解:它要的不是引擎,而是**一个产出引擎的 Future**——这允许真实引擎做耗时的异步初始化(加载权重等);sim 引擎是同步构造好的,所以用 `std::future::ready(Ok(engine.into()))` 包成"立即就绪"的 future。这是 sim 与真实引擎在启动契约上的唯一差异。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

```text
main():
  1. init_logging()                 # 装日志(Once)
  2. Args::parse()                  # clap 解析(语法层)
  3. build_runtime(&args)?          # 业务校验 + 组装 RuntimeConfig
  4. report_profile(&runtime)       # 打启动横幅(stderr)
  5. start_engine(&runtime.engine)  # 装配 Engine(起调度线程,下一讲)
  6. vllm::serve(...).await         # 挂 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP,阻塞到停机
```

任何一步失败(`?`)进程即退出,错误链由 anyhow 打印——步骤 3 的三类校验(互斥、model_id 冲突、max_model_len 冲突)都发生在这里。

#### 4.5.3 源码精读

[pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs:L207-L225](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/main.rs#L207-L225) 是 `main` 全文,8 个 `serve` 实参与 `RuntimeConfig`/`Args` 的对应关系:

| 实参 | 来源 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `std::future::ready(Ok(engine.into()))` | 第 5 步的 `engine` | 立即就绪的引擎 future;`into()` 转为前端的 `LaunchedEngine` |
| `&runtime.model_path` | `build_runtime` | tokenizer/config 元数据目录 |
| `runtime.served_model_name` | `build_runtime` | 对外模型名(空 Vec 时前端自行推导) |
| `ParserSelection::Auto` | 常量 | 工具调用解析器自动选择(按模型路径,见 [model_line.rs:L314-L321](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L314-L321) 的解析逻辑;u4-l3 详解) |
| `args.port` | CLI | 监听端口,默认 8000 |
| `Some(runtime.max_model_len)` | `build_runtime` | legacy: CLI/默认 8192;profile: 档案值 |
| `shutdown_token_from_ctrl_c()` | [vllm/mod.rs:L557-L561](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L557-L561) | Ctrl-C 触发优雅停机的 CancellationToken |

`serve` 的签名见 [pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs:L74-L82](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L74-L82),它内部委托给 `serve_with_engine_count`(默认引擎数 1)。第 5 步的 `start_engine` 定义在 [lib.rs:L174-L176](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L174-L176),是 `start_engine_with_partitions(config, 1)` 的别名——分区与调度线程模型是下一讲(u1-l3)的主题。

这套启动路径在测试里有逐行对应的样板:[tests/frontend_e2e.rs:L199-L225](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L199-L225) 的 `spawn_once` 同样是 `start_engine_with_partitions(...)` → `serve_with_engine_count(std::future::ready(Ok(engine.into())), ...)`,区别只有两点:测试用**显式** `CancellationToken`(可编程触发停机)而非 Ctrl-C;`max_model_len` 固定传 `Some(128)`(配合 tiny config 的 `max_position_embeddings`)。读懂了 `main`,你就同时读懂了所有 e2e 测试的服务器启动半边。

#### 4.5.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**:对照源码走一遍"从进程启动到 HTTP 监听"的时序,确认第 5、6 步的先后关系。
2. **操作步骤**:在 `serve` 调用前后各加一行 `eprintln!`(仅用于本地实验,**不要提交**),重新运行观察输出顺序;或直接运行综合实践的第 2 步,观察横幅出现与端口可访问的先后。
3. **需要观察的现象**:横幅(第 4 步)先于任何 HTTP 可达;Ctrl-C 后进程干净退出(第 6 步的 shutdown token 生效)。
4. **预期结果**:横幅 → 服务监听;Ctrl-C 一次即优雅退出(不是被 SIGINT 硬杀)。
5. Ctrl-C 的确切收尾日志**待本地验证**。

#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**:`serve` 的第一个参数为什么是 Future 而不是 `Engine`?

> **答案**:给异步初始化的引擎留出契约空间(权重加载可能几十秒)。sim 引擎同步构造,用 `std::future::ready` 立即满足;真实引擎可以在 future 里慢慢初始化,前端在等待期间可以继续做自己的准备。

**练习 2**:`Some(runtime.max_model_len)` 里这个 `Option` 表达什么?

> **答案**:对前端而言 `None` 意味着"由前端/模型配置自行决定上下文上限"。sim 永远显式给值(legacy 8192 或档案值),把决定权握在自己手里,保证报告给 `/v1/models` 的元数据与调度上限一致。

**练习 3**:e2e 测试为什么不用 `shutdown_token_from_ctrl_c()`?

> **答案**:测试进程里 Ctrl-C 不可编程控制;测试用自建的 `CancellationToken` 克隆一份传给 serve,`server.shutdown()` 时 cancel 即可确定性停机(`spawn_once` L207 的 `shutdown` 与 L209 的 `server_shutdown` 就是这一对克隆)。

把本讲的实践任务完整走一遍:启动服务器、验证三个端点、触发互斥报错。

**(1) 构造最小模型元数据目录**

前端搭 vLLM 协议栈需要 `tokenizer.json`、`tokenizer_config.json`、`config.json` 三个文件(e2e 测试的 [model_dir_with_minimal_metadata](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L373-L390) 就是这么写的,注释说明:token-id prompt 免编码,但**生成的 id 仍需 tokenizer 解码**)。在 pegainfer-sim 目录下建 `tmp-model/`,放入三个文件——`tokenizer.json` 直接照抄 [TINY_TOKENIZER_JSON](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L2106-L2136)(WordLevel 词表 `{"<unk>": 0, "alpha": 1, "beta": 2}`),`tokenizer_config.json` 照抄 [L2138-L2142](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L2138-L2142),`config.json` 照抄 [TINY_CONFIG_JSON](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L2153-L2157)。

**(2) 构建并启动**

```bash
cargo build --release -p pegainfer-sim
./target/release/pegainfer-sim --port 8001 --model-path tmp-model
```

预期 stderr 首行为 `active engine profile: legacy fixed TTFT/TPOT scheduler`,随后是前端监听日志(排版待本地验证)。

**(3) 三个端点逐一试**

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8001/health
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1/models
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"tmp-model","prompt":[1,2],"max_tokens":4}'
```

- `/health`:预期成功(2xx)。响应体格式待本地验证。
- `/v1/models`:预期 `object: "list"`;`data[0].id` 与 `model_path` 推导出的模型名相关(本例未同时给 `--model-id`,`served_model_name` 为空,由前端推导)。
- `/v1/completions`:token id `[1, 2]` 经词表解码为 `alpha beta`(id→词的映射即 tokenizer.json 的 vocab);生成的 4 个 token 均为 fallback id 0(`<unk>`)。可断言:`finish_reason == "length"`、`usage.prompt_tokens == 2`、`usage.completion_tokens == 4`、响应耗时约 \(5 + 2/100 + 3 \times 12 \approx 41\) 毫秒量级(首 token TTFT + 后续 3 个间隔;网络开销另计)。生成 text 的确切拼接(是否带空格)**待本地验证**。

**(4) 触发互斥报错**

```bash
./target/release/pegainfer-sim \
  --profile tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.json --tpot-ms 12
```

预期:进程立即退出,stderr 含 `--tpot-ms cannot be combined with --profile; timing comes from the profile`。对照 4.3 节源码,理解这句文案的两个成分:哪个参数非法(`{name}`)+ 为什么("timing comes from the profile")。

**(5) 反向确认 profile 车道可用**(选做)

去掉 `--tpot-ms` 再跑第 4 步的命令,并为档案模型准备元数据目录:`--model-path tmp-model`(档案 `model_id` 为 `pegainfer-sim-zero-cost`,见 [tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.manifest.json](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/fixtures/online-zero-cost.manifest.json),`model_path` 允许与之不同)。预期横幅变成 4.4 节描述的长行,`max_model_len` 等取档案值。档案车道的完整行为在 u3-l4 展开。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `Args` 用 `Option<T>` + 代码层默认(而非 `default_value_t`)承载三个定时参数,唯一目的就是让互斥校验能分辨"用户显式提供"。
- `build_runtime` 是两条车道的分岔点:profile 车道让档案成为模型身份与定时的唯一真相(CLI 只能确认不能改写),legacy 车道走 `model_id` 三级回退 + `DEFAULT_*` 常量。
- `ensure_legacy_timing_flags_are_absent` 用"数组 + find + bail"实现 fail-fast 互斥,且放在档案加载之前——最便宜的失败最先暴露;报错文案同时回答"哪个参数"和"为什么"。
- `report_profile` 是不受 `RUST_LOG` 影响的启动横幅,profile 车道打印的 sha256/调度参数/覆盖域是基准留档的依据;`init_logging` 用 `Once` 保证日志系统只装一次。
- `main()` 六步走:`init_logging → parse → build_runtime → report → start_engine → vllm::serve`;`serve` 收一个"产出引擎的 Future",sim 用 `std::future::ready` 立即满足——这正是模拟引擎与真实引擎在启动契约上的唯一差异,e2e 测试的 `spawn_once` 与之一一对应。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲我们两次把 `start_engine` 一笔带过。下一讲 **u1-l3《引擎契约接入:SimulatedEngineConfig 与 start_engine》**就补上这块:`SimulatedEngineConfig::new` 与全部 `with_*` builder 旋钮(脚本化补全、假想投机解码、假想前缀缓存等)、`start_engine_with_partitions` 如何用 `spawn_scheduler` 为每个分区起调度线程并装配前端可用的 `Engine`。建议先动手做一遍本讲综合实践,再进入下一讲——之后你阅读的每个 `spawn_with_config` 测试都会立刻眼熟。

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.
